notes: Entirely business-type entity (airport authority), GAAP accrual. Receipts/disbursements from Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p3). No single printed total receipts/expenses, so reported_totals were added up (computed) from operating revenue/expense totals plus nonoperating lines; check: receipts 29,666,608 - disbursements 25,783,051 = income before capital grants 3,883,557 (printed). Interest expense and loss on disposal of assets are nonoperating items listed as disbursements; farm income is shown net of expense. Capital contributions (non-federal 3,125,760 + federal 1,808,458 = Total Capital Grants 4,934,218) recorded as business_type.other_financing. Net position 98,028,996 + 3,883,557 + 4,934,218 = 106,846,771. No airport-specific function category exists, so airport operating lines use other (function not meaningful), except Public safety (public safety) and General and administrative (general government, second-pass audit A00817); object categories are in detail_category. Interest expense on p8-9 department lines is included in direct operating totals; the p3 nonoperating Interest expense 1,226,486 is separate. Schedule of Expenses by Natural Classification (p11) is a re-summary of the same expenses and was not itemized to avoid double counting (total expenses 25,698,062 includes both operating and interest). Balance sheet: Balance Sheets (p1-2) used as the net position statement. Proprietary cash flow figures from p4. Gained trimmed p5 (Statements of Cash Flows continued: reconciliation of operating loss to net cash, supplemental info) adds no new figures; page refs remapped after the v7 re-trim. Read pages 1-11 of 11.

decision_needed.question: The category list has no airport/transportation function. About 20.1M of this airport authority's 25.8M expenses (landing field, terminal, general aviation, enterprise park, Air Park South, service equipment, depreciation, loss on disposal) are recorded as 'other'. Should airport operations get their own function category (or be mapped to an existing one)?
